newspec-a: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
One run (final2, 07:26:40-07:28:08Z; every cited file written by it): same account, normal browser A vs wrong-clock browsers signed in through the form on that browser: B (Pacific/Honolulu, server+1 d; device day = server day at this run's hour) and B2 (UTC, server+1 d). 'NEW TODAY' on H3 and HX (added today by the server's day) shows in A and is missing in B and B2. Day/visit numbers: absent in every context (judged in S26/S06). Badge (known TFA-92584 AC 8): B2 shows Follow-up for H1/N1 (New Admission) and H2/N3 (Consult), and after B2 opened the list the NORMAL browser also showed Follow-up - B2's applyLifecycle wrote the roll to the server with its own day. DOB rows (record-only, Q12): N6 'DOB Oct 14, 1939' and N7 'DOB Oct 15, 1939' show no age in any context. Test fixed: it waits for the post-sign-in redirect before navigating (an earlier final run failed on 'page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED at /rounding'), has a 5 min timeout (took 1.5 min), and clears earlier tc01-s08-* files first.
产品问题: On a computer whose clock or time zone is off (here Hawaii time a day ahead, or UTC a day ahead), a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device's own date. Breaks UAT 3.8 ('A phone with a wrong clock, no clock set, or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device') and TFA-92579 AC 3/4. Known and worse: such a device also rolls New Admission / Consult to Follow-up on the server for every device (TFA-92584 AC 8).

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S08 「日期和时区都错的网页浏览器，显示一样的天数/就诊次数、徽章、New today 和按 DOB 算的年龄」 Web browser with the wrong date and time zone shows the same day/visit number, badge, 'New today' and DOB age

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 4；UAT 3.8）
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Same account and seededCensus in two Playwright browser contexts: A normal; B with timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' and page.clock.setSystemTime(server now + 1 d)

When Open the Hospital list and both Nursing Home lists in A and in B

Then For every card the day/visit number, the badge and the presence of 'New today' are identical in A and B; N6 (87th birthday today by server date) shows 87 and N7 (birthday tomorrow) shows 86 in both contexts

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8: identical state on both clocks; per card, compare A and B (card-scoped locators 'Open chart for <name>'). knownGaps: the badge mismatch only, 'TFA-92584 AC 8' (main computes the badge with localDay()). A day/visit number or 'New today' mismatch (main's 'New today' uses new Date()) reports against TFA-92579 AC 3/4. DOB rows: 87 / 86 in both contexts under Q12; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa；TFA-92584 ready for qa

电脑的时钟或时区差一天时，今天添加的病人没有别的设备上都有的「NEW TODAY」标签；在这台电脑上打开列表，还会把 New Admission / Consult 徽章改成 Follow-up，所有设备都跟着变。

On a computer whose clock or time zone is a day off, a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, and opening the list on that computer also flips New Admission and Consult badges to Follow-up for every device.

依据：newspec-a (final2 run). Browsers B (Honolulu, +1 d) and B2 (UTC, +1 d) both lose 'NEW TODAY' on H3/HX, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device date. This was only predicted in the TC-01 risks; it is not in the dev report or ledger, and the matrix sends it to TFA-92579 AC 3/4 as not known. The badge roll is known (TFA-92584 AC 8, device-clock localDay). DOB ages are recorded only (Q12). Day/visit numbers are missing in every context (see S06/S26).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S08

Web browser with the wrong date and time zone shows the same day/visit number, badge, 'New today' and DOB age

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Same seeded census, one account, two browser contexts: A normal; B with timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu and page.clock.setSystemTime(server now + 1 d). Read every card in A, then B, then A again (B's applyLifecycle runs with B's day). Compare per card: day/visit number, badge, 'New today'; N6/N7 ages 87/86. B and B2 (UTC, +1 d) sign in through the product form on the wrong-clock browser; the spec waits for the post-sign-in redirect before any page.goto and clears earlier tc01-s08-* evidence so all cited files come from one run. — Playwright contexts with timezoneId and page.clock on the local stack.

Detail:

One run (final2, 07:26:40-07:28:08Z; every cited file written by it): same account, normal browser A vs wrong-clock browsers signed in through the form on that browser: B (Pacific/Honolulu, server+1 d; device day = server day at this run's hour) and B2 (UTC, server+1 d). 'NEW TODAY' on H3 and HX (added today by the server's day) shows in A and is missing in B and B2. Day/visit numbers: absent in every context (judged in S26/S06). Badge (known TFA-92584 AC 8): B2 shows Follow-up for H1/N1 (New Admission) and H2/N3 (Consult), and after B2 opened the list the NORMAL browser also showed Follow-up - B2's applyLifecycle wrote the roll to the server with its own day. DOB rows (record-only, Q12): N6 'DOB Oct 14, 1939' and N7 'DOB Oct 15, 1939' show no age in any context. Test fixed: it waits for the post-sign-in redirect before navigating (an earlier final run failed on 'page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED at /rounding'), has a 5 min timeout (took 1.5 min), and clears earlier tc01-s08-* files first.

产品问题：On a computer whose clock or time zone is off (here Hawaii time a day ahead, or UTC a day ahead), a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device's own date. Breaks UAT 3.8 ('A phone with a wrong clock, no clock set, or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device') and TFA-92579 AC 3/4. Known and worse: such a device also rolls New Admission / Consult to Follow-up on the server for every device (TFA-92584 AC 8).

证据：附了 8 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): two Playwright contexts on a seeded fresh account, seeded through the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
